comment: The simulator capability matrix, read by the collector (SimulatorCatalog.cs, built in) and the website (src/lib/simulators.ts). status: supported = an adapter exists and has been tested; documented = channels read from the publisher's own documentation, no adapter; interfaceIdentified = interface found, channels not checked. support: collected, collectedAfterStint, documented (not yet confirmed in the simulator), unavailable, unknown (treat like unavailable). Only change a simulator to supported once its adapter has passed docs/multi-simulator.md's checklist against the real simulator. Researched 2026-11-01.

interfaces.name: .ibt in Documents\iRacing\telemetry
interfaces.note: The only source of Lat/Lon/Alt, and of tire surface temperatures, pressures and ride heights while driving

simulators.licensing: iRacing's SDK is used by a third-party open-source library; no new terms for this work.

pitch.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

roll.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

handbrake.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

tireCarcassTemp.note: Live values only update in the pit stall; continuous from the .ibt

wheelSpeed.note: iRacing records none; the website works out the rear's from RPM in each gear

slipRatio.note: The website estimates it (lapChannels.ts); estimated, not measured

slipAngle.note: The website estimates it (lapChannels.ts); estimated, not measured

tireWear.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

suspensionTravel.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

damperVelocity.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

oilPressure.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

turboBoost.note: In the SDK's variable list; not collected

interfaces.name: Local\acpmf_physics, Local\acpmf_graphics, Local\acpmf_static
interfaces.note: The same names as Assetto Corsa and AC Rally: tell them apart by the process and the static page's version strings

simulators.licensing: Kunos publishes the shared memory documentation for tool makers; no licence text for it was found. Confirm before a commercial release.
sources: ACC Shared Memory v1.8.12 (Kunos): https://github.com/rrennoir/PyAccSharedMemory/blob/main/ACCSharedMemoryDocumentationV1.8.12.pdf (a copy; the original is at https://www.assettocorsa.net/forum/index.php?threads/acc-shared-memory-documentation.59965/). A later contributor reports running shared memory v1.9 without finding newer documentation: check smVersion in the static page.

lapDistance.note: distanceTraveled is the stint's, and trackSplineLength is marked not used, so no meters along the lap

longAccel.note: accG; the document says global coordinates and gives no unit. Confirm its frame, unit and signs in the simulator

yaw.note: heading; confirm its zero and direction against iRacing's Yaw

yawRate.note: localAngularVel; confirm the axis and sign

velocityLocal.note: localVelocity; confirm the axes and signs against forward and left

worldPosition.note: carCoordinates, for the cars on track

geoPosition.note: No latitude or longitude, so no satellite maps or GPS driving lines

clutch.note: A pedal input: confirm it needs inverting to 1 = engaged

steeringAngle.note: steerAngle is the input from -1 to 1, not an angle

gear.note: Current gear; its numbering isn't stated. Confirm neutral and reverse in the simulator

absActive.note: abs; absInAction is marked not used

tirePressure.note: wheelPressure; no unit stated. Confirm it

tireCoreTemp.note: TyreCoreTemp, one value per tire; a different thing from iRacing's three carcass values

wheelSpeed.note: wheelAngularSpeed in rad/s; tyreRadius is marked not shown

slipRatio.note: Documented in radians, which isn't what a ratio is: confirm what it holds before showing it

fuelLevel.note: fuel; the document says kg while community readers say liters. Confirm it

fuelUse.note: fuelXLap is per lap, not a rate: don't convert it without a test

engineDamage.note: carDamage is by side of the car; no engine value

weather.note: airTemp, roadTemp, windSpeed, rain; no humidity

incidents.note: No such count; numberOfTyresOut is marked not used, so off-track needs another source too

trackId.note: track; trackConfiguration is marked not used

driverId.note: Names only; no stable account id

fieldCars.note: Positions and car IDs only: no names, times or running order here

interfaces.name: Local\acpmf_physics, Local\acpmf_graphics, Local\acpmf_static
interfaces.note: Shared names with ACC; layout not the same, and the static page has a version to check

simulators.requiresSetup: Options > System: set Shared Memory to Project CARS 2 (per community and vendor guides; confirm the labels in the installed version)

interfaces.name: Project CARS 2 format
interfaces.note: Off until turned on in the game's settings

simulators.licensing: Not confirmed. No Reiza documentation was found in this research.

simulators.requiresSetup: Settings > Gameplay: Enable Plugins on (per TinyPedal)

interfaces.name: LMU_Data
interfaces.note: Built in on Windows, per community tools. No primary documentation from the developer was found

simulators.licensing: Not confirmed. Community readers include GPL-3.0 code (TinyPedal): read them for facts, don't copy from them.

simulators.requiresSetup: Install and enable TheIronWolf's rF2 Shared Memory Map Plugin, then restart the game

interfaces.name: rF2SharedMemoryMapPlugin
interfaces.note: A third-party plugin mirroring the internals API; rFactor 2 has no shared memory by itself

simulators.licensing: The plugin's README allows including its DLL if the distribution is free and its readme is included. Paid RacingCoach.app plans may not meet that, so don't bundle it: have the user install it, or get permission.

interfaces.name: R3E Shared Memory API
interfaces.note: Published by the developer, with samples; process RRRE.exe

simulators.licensing: The developer's r3e-api repository is under the Unlicense.

interfaces.name: Local\acevo_pmf_physics and its siblings
interfaces.note: Early access: the names changed in 0.6 and broke tools, so expect the layout to move

simulators.licensing: Not confirmed. A Kunos guide on Steam is reported by a community project; not read here.

simulators.requiresSetup: UDP telemetry on in the game's settings

interfaces.name: F1 25 UDP specification
interfaces.note: Published by EA, changing year by year; a separate packet format for each game
